items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Paul told me. ... with Paul on trombone

ctx.x: I wish I'd have saw one more. What was that?
There were two of them. Yeah. I wish I'd known you were here. I didn't, I guess I didn't even know you were here Monday. But, uh, no, it was Monday night I found out, Paul told me.
Last time I came down here I saw one, but it was three years ago.
